ConfigFields.Description: Namespace for discovered IDs and configured models without aliases; a trailing slash is optional (default oauth).
ConfigFields.Name: model_prefix

ConfigFields.Description: Optional model allowlist: objects with name and optional alias. Empty discovers all eligible account models.
ConfigFields.Name: models

ConfigFields.Description: Case-insensitive model ID prefixes omitted from OpenAI discovery to prevent collisions with native providers.
ConfigFields.Name: models_excluded

ConfigFields.Description: Literal, env:NAME, or file:/absolute/path. Defaults to environment variable CLIENT_ID.
ConfigFields.Name: CLIENT_ID

ConfigFields.Description: Use env:CLIENT_SECRET or a protected file:/absolute/path. Literal secrets are visible in CLIProxyAPI configuration exports.
ConfigFields.Name: CLIENT_SECRET

ConfigFields.Description: Literal, env:NAME, or file:/absolute/path. Defaults to environment variable CLIENT_SCOPE.
ConfigFields.Name: CLIENT_SCOPE

ConfigFields.Description: Literal, env:NAME, or file:/absolute/path. Defaults to environment variable TOKEN_URL.
ConfigFields.Name: TOKEN_URL

ConfigFields.Description: Literal, env:NAME, or file:/absolute/path. Defaults to environment variable API_URL.
ConfigFields.Name: API_URL
